title: LGBTİ+ hesaplarıyla başlayan sansür dalgası Evrensel, Af Örgütü, MLSA ve Barış Akademisyenleri’ne uzandı
content:
Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularının sosyal medya hesaplarına yönelik erişim engellerinin ardından bugün çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı hakkında yeni erişim engeli kararları alındı.


Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği (MLSA) de engellenen hesaplar arasında.


İfade Özgürlüğü Derneği’nin (İFÖD) EngelliWeb projesi, bugün yaptığı açıklamada çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabına erişim engeli getirildiğini duyurdu.


EngelliWeb, “Bugün de aralarında Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesaplarının da bulunduğu çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı erişime engellendi. Hesapların bazıları Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı” açıklamasını yaptı.


X, MLSA, Af Örgütü ve Barış Akademisyenleri hesaplarını görünmez kıldı


İFÖD kurucularından Prof. Dr. Yaman Akdeniz de erişim engellerinin uygulanmaya başladığını belirterek MLSA ve Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye’nin X hesaplarının Türkiye’den görünmez kılındığını açıkladı.


Akdeniz, daha sonra Barış Akademisyenleri hesabının da aynı şekilde engellendiğini duyurdu:


“Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesapları erişime engellendi. MLSA ve Af Örgütü hesapları jet hızıyla X tarafından Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı. Sansür ve susturma operasyonu genişleyerek devam ediyor. An itibarıyla Barış Akademisyenleri’nin hesabı da Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı.”


Evrensel: Erişim şimdilik sürüyor


Evrensel Gazetesi Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Hakkı Özdal ise Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının gazetenin X hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, bu talebin X tarafından gazeteye bildirildiğini açıkladı.


Özdal, hesabın henüz Türkiye’den erişime kapatılmadığını belirterek şunları söyledi:


“Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının, gazetemizin X/Twitter hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, ilgili şirket bize de bildirdi. Şimdilik Evrensel hesabına yurt içinden erişim sürüyor. Ancak sansürün fiilen de hayata geçmesi durumunda yeni hesaplarımızı duyuracağız.”


Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri ve aktivistlerin hesapları engellendi


Yeni kararlar, hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularına yönelik operasyonlarla eş zamanlı uygulanan internet sansürünün ardından geldi.


İstanbul 7. Sulh Ceza Hâkimliği, 12 Eylül tarihli ve 2026/9559 sayılı kararıyla KaosGL Derneği’nin “kaosgldernegi.org” ve Velvele’nin “velvele.net” internet siteleri ile çok sayıda LGBTİ+ örgütü ve aktivistin sosyal medya hesaplarına erişim engeli getirdi.


Karar kapsamında aralarında KaosGL, Velvele, Özgür Renkler Derneği, Queer Adana, Cinsel Şiddetle Mücadele Derneği, İnter Dayanışma, İzmir LGBTİ+ Onur Haftası ve LİSTAG’ın da bulunduğu hesapların yanı sıra aktivistlerin kişisel hesapları hedef alındı.


Toplam 14 X hesabı platform tarafından Türkiye’den görünmez kılındı. Seyhan Arman, SPoD, Pembe Hayat Derneği, Boğaziçi Üniversitesi LGBTİA+ Kulübü, 17 Mayıs Derneği, Yıldız Tar, Hacettepe Kuir Araştırmaları, Enes Hocaoğulları, HEVİ LGBTİ+ Derneği, Bilkent Üniversitesi LGBTİQA+ Öğrenci Topluluğu ve İÜ Radar’a ait 11 Instagram hesabı hakkında da erişim engeli kararı verildi. Bu hesaplara yönelik karar ise açıklamanın yapıldığı sırada Instagram tarafından uygulanmamıştı.


(HA)

Το “κλείσιμο” της Α/Ι προκάλεσε και προκαλεί σειρά αντιδράσεων από συλλογικότητες και φορείς υπεράσπισης των ψηφιακών δικαιωμάτων, αλλά και ένα κύμα συμπαράστασης προς την πληττόμενη συλλογικότητα, ανοίγοντας ένα πεδίο νέου αγώνα.


Η Autistici/Inventati


Η A/I είναι μια συλλογικότητα που τη διαχειρίζονται εθελοντές και λειτουργεί από την Ιταλία από το 2001, παρέχοντας υπηρεσίες, ψηφιακή υποδομή και εργαλεία όπως email, λίστες αλληλογραφίας, φιλοξενία ιστολογίων και άλλες υπηρεσίες που σχετίζονται με την ιδιωτικότητα και την ανωνυμία, σε συλλογικότητες και άτομα σε όλη την Ευρώπη και παγκοσμίως. Πρόκειται για μια αντιφασιστική, αντιρατσιστική, αντισεξιστική και αντιμιλιταριστική οργάνωση που αντιτίθεται στον καπιταλισμό και τον αυταρχισμό και φιλοξενεί μόνο όσους συμμερίζονται αυτές τις αρχές και που φιλοξενεί 16.000 mails, 1.500 ιστότοπους, 5.500 λίστες αλληλογραφίας και 10.000 ιστολόγια.


Η

Autistici/Inventati όπως αναφέρει στο μανιφέστό της

Το δηλωμένο μοντέλο είναι ριζικά διαφορετικό από αυτό των μεγάλων εμπορικών πλατφορμών. Καμία διαφήμιση, καμία πώληση προσωπικών δεδομένων, καμία αποζημίωση για εθελοντές. author: EDRi
title: Europe’s cookie law is really a law about surveillance
content:
The ePrivacy framework limits commercial tracking and state access to communications. It is now being weakened from several directions at once.

By Itxaso Domínguez de Olazábal & Chiara Casati (guest author) · September 10, 2026

In 2022, a reporter paid $160 for a week’s worth of location data linked to visits to over 600 Planned Parenthood clinics in the United States. The dataset showed where groups of visitors had come from, how long they stayed, and where they went next. The broker withdrew the product after the story was published. However, the market behind it remained.

Europe has seen a similar market emerge. Journalists have obtained billions of commercially traded location records from Germany and Belgium. The data exposed movements around hospitals, religious sites, trade union offices, government ministries, military sites, EU institutions and NATO buildings. Information gathered through ordinary apps for advertising can reveal intimate details of people’s lives, identify public officials and create security risks for entire institutions.

These examples illustrate a distinction at the heart of what people usually call ‘EU privacy law’ that may seem unnecessarily fussy to readers elsewhere. In the United States, ‘privacy’ often covers the whole problem, while EU law recognises two distinct fundamental rights. Article 7 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the Union protects private life, the home and communications, while Article 8 protects personal data.

The distinction is quite important: whereas data protection largely governs what happens when personal data are processed, privacy and communications confidentiality also protect the space from which information is obtained. They put a boundary on entering that space in the first place. The EU built the ePrivacy framework around that question. ePrivacy adds specific rules for the confidentiality of communications and access to information stored on, or generated by, people’s devices, including rules covering communications, metadata, and location. While the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) primarily governs access to personal data — what organizations might do with data once they have processed it. This distinction matters, and it disappears when ‘privacy’ becomes a casual synonym for data protection.

Most people meet ePrivacy through a cookie banner, and this may be the worst possible introduction. A framework about confidentiality looks like a tedious set of rules about pop-ups, while the tracking industry points to the pop-ups it helped create as proof that the law has failed. Article 5(3), the provision behind many banners, controls when an actor may store information on, or obtain information from, a person’s terminal equipment. But it goes beyond that: ePrivacy is concerned with the act of accessing the device itself. “Terminal equipment” includes phones and laptops, connected cars, televisions, wearables, smart glasses and other parts of the Internet of Things. The rule covers fingerprinting, tracking pixels, local storage, operating-system identifiers and instructions that make a device send information elsewhere. The principle is straightforward: a device does not become open to inspection simply because one fragment of information cannot identify its user on its own. ePrivacy also protects communications confidentiality and regulates the traffic and location data held by communications providers. It limits retention and reuse, covers unsolicited communications, and sets the conditions under which Member States may restrict confidentiality.

The ePrivacy Directive’s scope has never matched the way people use digital services. It was written around traditional telephone and communications providers, meaning that many online services originally were excluded from its protection. Messaging and webmail services can now fall under communications confidentiality rules, but coverage still depends on legal classifications that users cannot see. The same message, location trail, or device data can receive different protection depending on whether the company is labeled a telecom provider, messaging service, or platform: under these conditions, is the law still protecting the underlying right?

The distinction between GDPR and ePrivacy becomes even more important when we look at surveillance. From one side, commercial surveillance commonly starts before the GDPR question even arises, with access to a device or a communications-related …

author: Jian Zharese Joies Sanz
title: Tech professionals warn of privacy risks in proposed ID rule for Meta users
content:
MANILA – The Computer Professionals’ Union (CPU) sounded the alarm over the Department of Information and Communications Technology’s (DICT) proposal to require social media users to have the Philippine National ID.

The DICT claimed that the proposal would be the ‘safest’ way of verifying age of social media users, following the government’s statement blaming social media and online games for the series of school shootings in the country.

The CPU, however, maintained that the proposal is alarming and profoundly intrusive to Filipino citizens’ digital rights. “Rather than fostering a safe online environment, this draconian measure represents a clear and direct attack on the basic human right to privacy without any legitimate grounds that it will protect us from crime, or protect our youth from the culture of violence,” the union said.

Beyond possible violations of citizens’ privacy, the CPU said the rule strips away the right to anonymity, threatens free expression, and can become a dangerous tool for mass surveillance.

The group pointed out that the SIM Registration Law did not address the incidence of cybercrime after it was enacted into law under Ferdinand Marcos Jr’ s administration.

Despite the law’s promise to stop cybercrime and scams, reports of digital crimes have reportedly tripled in 2024, according to the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC). In an online article, the CICC recorded more than 10,004 cybercrime complaints in 2024 and P198 million ($3.16 million) in monetary losses from these incidents.

The CPU asserted that the proposal will also not solve the issues of online exploitation or youth violence. According to them, the real solution is a better system—accessible mental health services, comprehensive digital literacy programs integrated into educational systems, and stricter gun control measures to prevent real-world violence. (AMU, RVO)

author: C4SS
title: An Attack on Tech Freedom, an Assault on Dissent
content:
We live in a world of

surveillance states

,

militarized police

, and

crackdowns


on


dissent

. Meanwhile, corporate behemoths will often ally with the state to

shut down dissident speech

 or aid and abet

surveillance

. 


In this context, it’s important for independent groups to develop and maintain encrypted communications platforms and independent web hosting.


But the Trump administration recently

declared

 that an Italian tech collective is a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” for doing exactly this. That Italian tech collective is Autistici/Inventati, which operates the independent web hosting service

NoBlogs

 along with other digital infrastructure projects for activists.


The State Department

claims

 that “Autistici/Inventati (A/I Collective) is an Italy-based extremist group that builds and operates the digital infrastructure for violent Antifa cells and other far-left militants across the world.”


That emphasis on

Antifa cells

 reflects the Trump administration’s ongoing attempt to crack down on dissent by demonizing “Antifa.” This has been the explicit aim of

NSPM-7

, and it has been central to prosecutions of anti-ICE activists, including the

Minneapolis 15

 and the

Prairieland defendants

.


In their obsessive desire to tie all leftist and anarchist dissent to “Antifa,” the Trump administration has made blatantly false claims. The State Department asserts: 


Oregon-based Rose City Antifa has relied on A/I Collective tools and services to organize and incite violent and criminal acts domestically, including an attack on Customs and Border Patrol helicopters that led to a federal indictment. Rose City Antifa also used A/I Collective tools and services to disseminate doxing lists and release illegally obtained personal information of Federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with calls for targeted attacks on ICE agents in the streets and “in their homes.” 


However, as Torch Antifa Network

points out

, Rose City Antifa does not use A/I services and did not carry out these actions. Federal officials are instead referring to communications by Rose City Counter-Info, an entirely different group that does use A/I services. “Rose City” is a common nickname for Portland, Oregon. Not all groups that use this phrase in their name are identical. These outright falsehoods were credulously amplified by reporters at

Fox News

 and the

National Review

. 


Yet despite the incompetence this shows, designating A/I Collective as a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” poses a very serious threat. As C4SS’s Technical Coordinator William Gillis

put it

, “This is a HUGE attack on basic free speech. Words completely fail me when addressing the potential loss to the anarchist movement of — as the US names it — 5,500 mailing lists, and 10,000 blogs.”


The State Department emphasizes users of the A/I Collective’s services that have allegedly committed crimes, including sabotage and terrorism. But many users are engaged in clearly First Amendment protected activities. These include anarchist bookfairs, antifascist researchers who study and expose far-right groups, the blog of a peer-reviewed academic journal, and an anarchist podcast and radio show. 


The “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” classification subjects Autistici/Inventati to sanctions. This means that purely based on a decree from the U.S. executive branch, anyone who engages in transactions with the A/I Collective becomes vulnerable to legal reprisal. As a result, the collective’s website has been

taken down

,

PayPal

 has blocked their account, and the Italian bank

Banca Etica

 plans to close their account. 


These sanctions have had a devastating effect on the A/I Collective. As

Sabot Media

reports

, “On September 6, eleven days after the United States placed the Italian technology collective on its terrorism sanctions list, A/I announced that the collective itself will close and that the email, blogging, hosting and communications services it has provided for a quarter century will soon be discontinued.” 


This is a chilling precedent. The executive branch can unilaterally declare that a provider of web hosting, email services, and other communications infrastructure is a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist.” By doing so, they can impose sanctions, and thereby destroy that provider. This can impose serious costs on speakers, organizers, and researchers that use the providers’ services. And …

title: Yemen: Bölgesel savaşın kesişim noktası
content:
Yemen'i yöneten Husiler (Ensarullah hareketi) Kızıldeniz boyunca önemli ilerleme sağladı

Yemen’de 2026 yazında yeniden alevlenen çatışmalar, on yılı aşkın süredir devam eden iç savaşın sınırlarını aşarak bölgesel ve küresel bir boyut kazandı. Ensarullah (Husi) güçlerinin Taiz ve Hudeyde vilayetlerinde ilerleyerek Muha Limanı, Büyük ve Küçük Hanış adaları ile stratejik Meyun (Perim) Adası’nı kontrol altına alması, Babülmendeb Boğazı üzerindeki fiili güç dengesini değiştirdi. Bu gelişme, 2022’de BM himayesinde sağlanan ateşkesten bu yana temas hatlarında yaşanan en önemli saha değişimlerinden biri olarak değerlendiriliyor.

Çatışmaların yeniden başlamasının doğrudan tetikleyicisi, temmuz 2026’da İran’ın Dini Lideri Ali Hamaney’in cenaze törenine katılan Mahan Air uçağının Sana Havalimanı’na inişinin engellenmesi ve Suudi savaş uçaklarının havalimanının pistlerini hedef alması oldu. Husiler buna karşılık Suudi gemilerine deniz yasağı ilan etti, petrol tankerlerini ve batı kıyısındaki askeri tesisleri hedef aldı. Ağustos-eylül döneminde Muha, Hays, Huhha ve Zubab cephelerinde operasyonların genişlemesiyle Suudi destekli Başkanlık Konseyi güçleri 120 kilometreden fazla geri çekildi.

Yemen’in parçalı bir yapıya sahip olduğunu hatırlatmakta fayda var. Husiler, Yemen’in kuzeyini kontrol ederken Yemen’in güneyi ise Suudi Arabistan ile BAE tarafından desteklenen güçler tarafından kontrol ediliyor. BAE tarafından desteklenen ve Yemen’in güneyinin bağımsızlığını savunan Güney Geçiş Konseyi (GGK) ile Suudi Arabistan tarafından desteklenen, uluslararası alanda tanınan Yemen Başkanlık Konseyi bünyesindeki farklı askeri ve siyasi güçler arasındaki ayrışmalar, Husilere karşı mücadele eden güçlerin koordinasyonunu zayıflatan unsurlar arasında gösteriliyor. Buna yanı sıra yine BAE destekli Tarık Salih liderliğindeki Ulusal Direniş güçleri, batı kıyısındaki önemli askeri yapılardan biri olarak öne çıkıyor. Bu grupların farklı dış desteklere, yerel siyasi hedeflere ve askeri komuta yapılarına sahip olması, Husilere karşı ortak bir cephe oluşturulmasını güçleştirdi. Burada 2026 başlarında Yemen konusunda Suudi Arabistan ve BAE arasında çıkan anlaşmazlıklar sonrası BAE’nin Yemen’den çekilmek zorunda kaldığını hatırlatalım. Buna karşılık Husiler, daha merkezi bir komuta yapısı, yoğun ateş gücü ve ablukaya rağmen sahip oldukları silah ve lojistik imkanlarla sahadaki inisiyatifi ele geçirdi.

Stratejik sonuçlar ise daha geniş bir çerçeveye işaret ediyor. Dünya ticaretinin yaklaşık yüzde 12’sinin geçtiği Babülmendeb’in kontrolü, Husilere deniz ulaşımı üzerinde baskı kurma imkanı sağlarken, Başkanlık Konseyi’nin bölgesel ve uluslararası aktörlerle ilişkilerini sürdürme kapasitesini de zayıflatıyor. Askeri açıdan batı kıyısının ve çevresindeki deniz alanlarının kontrol altına alınması, ablukanın aşılması açısından önemli bir lojistik mevzi sağlarken, silah kaçakçılığı güzergahlarını hedef alma imkanını da artırıyor. Bölgesel düzeyde ise bu gelişme, Hürmüz Boğazı’ndaki gerilimle birlikte İran-ABD-İsrail çatışmasının Kızıldeniz’e uzanan boyutunu güçlendiriyor. Husiler, Suudi gemileri dışındaki deniz trafiğini etkilemeyeceklerini açıklayarak bağımsız bir pozisyon vurgulasa da, Babülmendeb’teki gelişmeler İran’ın iki kritik boğaz üzerinden siyasi manevra alanını genişletmesine imkan sağlıyor.

Bu arada Suudi Veliaht Prensi Muhammed bin Selman, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump’tan Ensarullah’a karşı askeri destek istedi. Ancak Trump’ın doğrudan ABD saldırılarının gerçekleştirilmesini reddettiği ve Husilerle anlaşma yolunu tercih ettiği belirtiliyor. Lübnan merkezli El Ahbar gazetesinde, Bin Selman’ın bölge ülkelerinden de gerekli desteği bulamaması üzerine ABD, Mısır, Pakistan ve Türkiye’nin girişimleri sonucu Husilerle müzakere masasına oturma noktasına geldiğine işaret edildi. Haberde Suudi Arabistan’ın, iki hafta sürecek bir ateşkes kapsamında çatışmaların durdurulmasını ve Ensarullah liderleriyle doğrudan görüşmeler yapılmasını teklif ettiği aktarıldı. El-Ahbar’ın edindiği bilgilere göre Suudi Arabistan, Yemen ablukasını kaldırmaya ve ülkeye yardım girişine izin vermeye hazır olduğunu bildirdi.

Husiler ise “hava, kara ve deniz olmak üzere ablukanın bütün biçimleriyle sona erdirilmesini; Suudi Arabistan’ın Yemen sahnesinden askeri, güvenlik ve siyasi açıdan tamamen çekilmesini ve Suudi saldırısının Yemen kentleri ile altyapısında yol açtığı tahribatın giderilmesi için mali tazminatları ödenmesini” talep ediyor.

author: ak-Interview: Guido Speckmann, ak 729
title: »Wir wollen das kriegsunwillige Hamburg«
content:
Tina Reiß von der Interventionistischen Linken, aktiv im Bündnis Rheinmetall Entwaffnen, über die geplanten Aktionstage in der Hansestadt Ende September.


Deutschland rüstet auf, zugleich wächst der Druck auf den Sozialstaat. Doch wie hängen Militarisierung, Sozialabbau und Klimakrise zusammen? Ein Gespräch über neuen Antimilitarismus, die alte Friedensbewegung und Proteste gegen die Kriegstüchtigkeit.


Frage: Die massive Aufrüstung ist nur eines von vielen Themen, die aus linker Perspektive hohen Handlungsdruck erzeugen. Warum engagierst du dich gerade in der antimilitaristischen Bewegung?


Tina Reiß: Ich begreife mich als radikale Linke. Und das bedeutet, keine Themenfeldpolitik zu machen, sondern einen umfassenden Begriff gesellschaftlicher Veränderung zu haben. Aufrüstung ist zurzeit ein besonders drängendes Thema, weil die Kriegslogik viele gesellschaftliche Bereiche durchdringt: Junge Leute bekommen Post von der Bundeswehr, täglich geht es um neue Rüstungsdeals und steigende Militärausgaben, während beim Sozialen gespart wird. Militarismus fördert mit seiner Logik von Sieg und Niederlage zudem autoritäre Tendenzen und Faschisierung. Militarisierung lässt sich zudem weder von den sozialen Kämpfen noch von der Klimakrise trennen. Die Ressourcen sind endlich und damit droht der Kampf um Zugriff auf Ressourcen, Rohstoffe und bewohnbare Orte immer gewalttätiger ausgetragen zu werden.


Frage: Du warst Anfang September auf dem Rheinmetall-Entwaffnen-Camp in Köln. Welche drei Dinge nimmst du von dort mit?


Erstens war das Camp mit weit über 2.000 Menschen größer und vielfältiger als in den vergangenen Jahren. Darin zeigt sich das wachsende Bedürfnis, sich mit Militarisierung und Aufrüstung auseinanderzusetzen und dagegen zu protestieren. Zweitens war die internationale Solidarität mit Menschen wichtig, die von Krieg betroffen sind oder sich dagegen auflehnen. Und drittens waren viele Aktive aus der Klimabewegung, den Sozialprotesten und der Schulstreikbewegung dabei. Auch darin zeigt sich, wie viele gesellschaftliche Bereiche die Militarisierung inzwischen berührt und dass neue Allianzen gesucht werden.


Ende September geht es weiter: Rheinmetall Entwaffnen mobilisiert gegen das Nato-Manöver Red Storm Charlie in Hamburg. Wie laufen die Vorbereitungen?


Die Vorbereitungen laufen gut. Schon in den vergangenen zwei Jahren gab es Proteste gegen das Nato-Manöver in Hamburg, auf denen wir aufbauen können. Dass Rheinmetall Entwaffnen dieses Jahr mit Köln und Hamburg gleich zwei große Aktionen organisiert, entspricht der Dringlichkeit der Situation und bietet die Chance, die antimilitaristische Bewegung zu verbreitern.


Worum geht es euch bei den Protesten in Hamburg?


Red Storm Charlie ist für uns exemplarisch, weil dort die zivil-militärische Zusammenarbeit auf der Ebene einer Großstadt geübt wird. Hamburg soll zum Logistik-Hub und Drehkreuz für einen möglichen Krieg gegen Russland auf- und ausgebaut werden. Dagegen wehren wir uns. Wir wollen nicht das kriegstüchtige, sondern das kriegsuntaugliche und kriegsunwillige Hamburg. Unser Fokus liegt dabei auf der Zusammenarbeit des Militärs mit zivilen Krankenhäusern, Rettungsdiensten, dem Arbeitsamt und Lebensmittelhändlern. Wir sehen darin eine Normalisierung des Krieges: Zivile Institutionen werden zu Akteuren einer Kriegsmobilisierung gemacht und Krieg als beherrschbares Szenario dargestellt, für das man nur genug üben müsse. Der Krieg ist aber die Katastrophe.


Warum ist Hamburg für die Nato so wichtig?


Es geht nicht nur um den Hafen. In Hamburg gibt es viel militärische Infrastruktur, etwa die Führungsakademie und die Universität der Bundeswehr. Hinzu kommt die lange Geschichte der Rüstungsproduktion in den Hamburger Werften. Über den Hafen werden außerdem Rüstungstransporte in aktuelle Kriegsregionen abgewickelt, und große Rüstungsunternehmen sind dort vertreten. Rheinmetall hat sein Engagement im Hafen zuletzt ebenfalls ausgebaut.


Früher war Antimilitarismus vor allem ein Thema der Friedensbewegung. Seit der Krim-Annexion durch Russland 2014 zeigt sich die alte Friedensbewegung in Teilen offen für eine Querfront. Wer engagiert sich heute in den antimilitaristischen Protesten?


Ich würde Konfliktlinien schon viel früher ansetzen. Nach den Anschlägen vom 11. September 2001 schwenkte ein Teil auch der radikalen Linken auf die Selbsterzählung des Westens als Zufluchtsort vor der Barbarei ein und war bereit, westliche Kriege hinzunehmen oder zu rechtfertigen …

author: Unknown
title: Donald Trump, varolan askeri hakların yenilenmesini "Grönland'da kontolü ele geçirdim" diye duyurdu
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Danimarka ve Grönland ile henüz imzalanmamış güvenlik anlaşması güncellemesini, ABD’ye Grönland’da “ne gerekiyorsa yapma” hakkı kazandıran ve hiçbir zaman sona ermeyecek bir düzenleme olarak ilan etti.


Danimarka Başbakanlığının açıklaması ise üç hükümetin anlaşmayı gelecek hafta New York’taki Birleşmiş Milletler Genel Kurulu sırasında imzalamasının beklendiğini gösteriyor. Düzenleme, imzalandıktan sonra Danimarka ve Grönland’daki parlamenter süreçlerin tamamlanmasıyla yürürlüğe girecek.


Anlaşma metni de henüz kamuoyuna açıklanmadı. Bu nedenle Trump’ın ABD’ye “güvenlik ve diğer bütün ihtiyaçlar üzerinde sürekli denetim” verildiği ve düzenlemenin Washington’a hiçbir maliyet getirmeyeceği yönündeki iddialarını doğrulayan bir metin yok. 


Trump, Truth Social hesabından yayımladığı açıklamada ABD’nin Danimarka Krallığı ve Grönland ile bir anlaşmaya girdiğini belirterek şöyle dedi:


“Bu anlaşma, Grönland’daki güvenlik ve diğer bütün ihtiyaçlar üzerinde ABD’ye sürekli denetim sağlıyor ve ABD’nin bütün kaygılarını tamamen gideriyor. ABD için hiçbir maliyeti olmayacak. ABD, Grönland’ı ve Amerika Birleşik Devletleri’ni korumak için Grönland’da gerekli olan her şeyi yapma yeteneğine sonsuza kadar sahip olacak.”


Trump ayrıca Washington’ın yazılı izni olmadan hiçbir “ABD hasmının” Grönland’da üs kuramayacağını, askeri varlık bulunduramayacağını veya hassas yatırımlar yapamayacağını ileri sürdü.


Düzenlemeyi “Sonsuz Ömürlü Anlaşma” diye adlandıran Trump, “Bunun sonu yok” dedi ve ABD’nin Grönland’ın “uygun bölgelerinde” büyük bir askeri varlık oluşturma çalışmalarına hemen başlayacağını açıkladı.


Danimarka: "Anlaşma henüz imzalanmadı"


Trump’ın “sürekli denetim” iddiasına karşılık Danimarka Başbakanlığı, anlaşmanın henüz imzalanmadığını açıkladı. Üç hükümetin düzenlemeyi gelecek hafta New York’taki Birleşmiş Milletler Genel Kurulu sırasında imzalaması bekleniyor.


Açıklamaya göre anlaşma, imzanın ardından Danimarka ve Grönland’daki gerekli parlamenter süreçler tamamlanmadan yürürlüğe girmeyecek.


Danimarka Başbakanı Mette Frederiksen, düzenlemenin Kuzey Kutup Bölgesi (Arktik) ve Kuzey Atlantik’te ortak güvenliği güçlendireceğini söyledi. Frederiksen, anlaşmanın “Danimarka Krallığı’nın egemenliğini ve toprak bütünlüğünü ve Grönland halkının kendi kaderini tayin hakkını tanıdığını” özellikle vurguladı.


Danimarka hükümeti böylece Trump’ın ABD’nin Grönland üzerinde “sürekli denetim” elde ettiği yolundaki açıklamasını doğrulamadı. Açıklamada ABD’ye herhangi bir egemenlik hakkı devredildiğine veya Grönland’ın güvenlik dışındaki bütün alanlarında söz hakkı tanındığına ilişkin bir ifade de yer almadı.


Grönland: "Anlaşma çıkarlarımızı tanıyor"


Grönland Özerk Hükümeti Başkanı Jens-Frederik Nielsen, tarafların anlaşmaya varmak üzere olmasını memnuniyetle karşıladı.


Nielsen, düzenlemenin Grönland’ın, Danimarka Krallığı’nın, ABD’nin ve Batı İttifakı’nın güvenliğini güçlendireceğini söyledi. Anlaşmanın “Grönland’ın çıkarlarını ve uluslararası işbirliğindeki yerini tanıdığını” belirten Nielsen de ABD’ye denetim veya egemenlik devrinden söz etmedi.


Dolayısıyla Trump’ın kullandığı “anlaşmaya girdik”, “sürekli denetimi aldık” ve “hemen başlayacağız” ifadeleri, tarafların açıkladığı hukuki durumu yansıtmıyor.


ABD’nin askeri varlığı II. Dünya Savaşı’na uzanıyor


Trump, “Başkanlar yüz yılı aşkın süredir Grönland’ın stratejik önemini biliyordu ancak hiçbiri bu konuda bir şey yapamadı” dedi. Oysa ABD’nin Grönland’daki askeri varlığı İkinci Dünya Savaşı’na kadar uzanıyor.


ABD ile Danimarka arasında 1941’de imzalanan savunma anlaşması, Nazi Almanyası’nın Danimarka’yı işgali sırasında ABD’nin Grönland’ın savunmasını üstlenmesine ve adada askeri tesisler kurmasına olanak verdi.


Savaş sonrasında bu düzenlemenin yerini, Danimarka’nın NATO’ya katılmasının ardından 1951’de imzalanan Grönland Savunma Anlaşması aldı. Anlaşma ABD’ye adada askeri üsler kurma, mevcut tesisleri kullanma ve askeri unsurlarını serbestçe hareket ettirme hakkı verdi.


Düzenleme 2004’te imzalanan Igaliku Anlaşması’yla güncellendi ve Grönland hükümetinin sürece katılımı güçlendirildi.


ABD halen Grönland’ın kuzeybatısındaki Pituffik Uzay Üssü’nü işletiyor. Eski adı Thule Hava Üssü olan tesis, füze erken uyarı sistemleri, uzay gözetimi ve Kuzey Amerika’nın savunması bakımından ABD ordusunun başlıca Arktik üslerinden biri.


Reuters’a göre ABD, 1951 anlaşması sayesinde Grönland’da zaten çok geniş uçuş, üslenme ve askeri erişim …

author: infolibre
title: Αντιπολεμική συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης σε Παλαιστίνη και Λίβανο, Σάββατο 19/9, 19.00, στο Σταθμό ΗΣΑΠ Μοναστηράκι
content:
Η

Συνέλευση Αλληλεγγύης με την Παλαιστινιακή Αντίσταση

, καλεί και αυτό το Σάββατο 19 Σεπτεμβρίου στις 19:00, στην πλατεία Μοναστηρακίου στην Αθήνα, όλους όσους σε όλο τον κόσμο αγωνίζονται ενάντια στον ιμπεριαλισμό και τον αποικιοκρατισμό να ενώσουν τις φωνές και τι δυνάμεις καταγγέλλοντας τη συνεργασία του ελληνικού κράτος με το γενοκτονικό κράτος του Ισραήλ, ώστενα μην

“αφήσουμε να γίνει η νέα κανονικότητα” η γενοκτονία και

ο σφαγιασμός ολόκληρων οικογενειών  σε Λίβανο, Δυτική Όχθη και

Γάζα

.


Από τη

Συνέλευση Αλληλεγγύης με την Παλαιστινιακή Αντίσταση

:


Αυτό το καλοκαίρι, ενώ τα κρουαζιερόπλοια πηγαινοέρχονται ανάμεσα στα νησιά και οι τουρίστες κατακλύζουν την πόλη και τις παραλίες, η γενοκτονία στη Γάζα, τη Δυτική Όχθη και τον Λίβανο συνεχίζεται. Οι σιωνιστές και οι υποστηρικτές τους στις ΗΠΑ και την Ευρώπη γνωρίζουν μόνο τη διαρκή επιθετικότητα· επωφελούνται από την επέκταση των θεάτρων πολέμου και έχουν οργανωθεί με σκοπό να συνεχίσουν τις επιθέσεις τους. Αυτό το βλέπουμε πρώτα απ’ όλα στην ίδια τη σιωνιστική οντότητα, όπου ολόκληρη η οικονομία στηρίζεται σε τεχνολογία που έχει αναπτυχθεί για την περαιτέρω αυτοματοποίηση του πολέμου, την παρακολούθηση ολόκληρων πληθυσμών και τη στρατιωτικοποίηση των συνόρων.


Στη Γάζα, αυτή η τεχνολογία χρησιμοποιείται καθημερινά. Από την κατάπαυση του πυρός, έχουν σκοτωθεί πάνω από 1.300 Παλαιστίνιοι, ενώ ο αριθμός των έμμεσων θανάτων από την πείνα, τις ασθένειες και την παρατεταμένη κατοχή είναι σίγουρα πολύ υψηλότερος. Τα τετρακόπτερα πυροβολούν συστηματικά πολίτες που έχουν καταφύγει σε σκηνές, ενώ οι Ισραηλινές Δυνάμεις Κατοχής (IOF) συνεχίζουν να ωθούν την «Κίτρινη Γραμμή» πιο βαθιά μέσα στη Λωρίδα της Γάζας, απειλώντας να πυροβολήσουν όποιον δεν μετακινηθεί μαζί της. Στα σημεία ελέγχου των IOF, τα είδη πρώτης ανάγκης κατασχέονται συστηματικά, με αποτέλεσμα να μην περνάει ούτε καν το πιο βασικό εφόδιο.


Στη Δυτική Όχθη, οι IOF έχουν σκοτώσει πάνω από 70 Παλαιστινίους μόνο φέτος· και έχουν φυλακίσει, με τη βοήθεια της προδοτικής Παλαιστινιακής Αρχής, εκατοντάδες άλλους. Αγόρια πυροβολούνται στους δρόμους της Τζενίν, της Ναμπλούς και της Ραμάλα. Μέσα στις φυλακές της κατοχής, οι φρικτές συνθήκες τεκμηριώνονται και βιντεοσκοπούνται από τους ίδιους τους σιωνιστές, όπως είδαμε πρόσφατα, όταν ο Μπεν Γκβίρ βιντεοσκόπησε τον εαυτό του και άλλους να εισβάλλουν στη γυναικεία φυλακή του Νταμούν. Ο βιασμός και άλλες μορφές βασανιστηρίων είναι συνηθισμένες. Οπλισμένοι έποικοι εισβάλλουν με τη βία σε εδάφη που πιστεύουν ότι τους έχουν υποσχεθεί, σκοτώνοντας Παλαιστινίους, βασανίζοντας και σκοτώνοντας ζώα, και ξεριζώνοντας ελαιόδεντρα, πολλά από τα οποία είναι παλαιότερα από την ίδια τη σιωνιστική οντότητα. Για τη Δυτική Όχθη, τη Γάζα και το Νότιο Λίβανο, δεν υπάρχει άλλο σχέδιο παρά τη πλήρη καταστροφή και τη γενοκτονία. Δεν θα σταματήσουν μέχρι να ισοπεδώσουν τη γη, ώστε να χτίσουν τις πόλεις τους πάνω στους τάφους και τα οστά εκείνων που έχουν σφαγιάσει.


Αυτό δεν πρέπει ποτέ να κανονικοποιηθεί. Δεν μπορούμε να αφήσουμε τον εαυτό μας να μουδιάσει από τη συνεχή γενοκτονία. Η ελπίδα τους είναι να χάσουμε τη θέληση να αγωνιστούμε, να αποφασίσουμε να υποχωρήσουμε στα όρια της δικής μας άνεσης και ασφάλειας, ώστε το σιωνιστικό εγχείρημα να μπορέσει να συνεχίσει το όραμά του. Για τον λόγο αυτό είναι σημαντικό να επαναλάβουμε ότι οι Παλαιστίνιοι, καθώς και οι σύμμαχοί τους σε ολόκληρη τη Δυτική Ασία, δεν είναι απλώς θύματα. Έχουν επιλέξει την αντίσταση επειδή δεν έχουν άλλη επιλογή· κατανοούν αυτό που εμείς στην Ευρώπη και στον Βόρειο Κόσμο δεν χρειάστηκε ποτέ να κατανοήσουμε – ότι η μαχητική αντιπαράθεση με τον ιμπεριαλισμό και την κατοχή είναι αναγκαιότητα.


Από τα χωράφια του Νότιου Λιβάνου, όπου τα μη επανδρωμένα αεροσκάφη της Χεζμπολά έχουν αναγκάσει τους σιωνιστές στρατιώτες να υποχωρήσουν στα καταφύγιά τους, μέχρι τα χωριά της Δυτικής Όχθης, όπου άνθρωποι όπως ο Φαρούκ Αντνάν Αλί Ραμαντάν αντιστέκονται ατρόμητα στις εισβολές των εποίκων στα εδάφη τους, μέχρι τη Γάζα, όπου ο λαός συνεχίζει να αντιστέκεται στην κατοχή και τις πολιτοφυλακές της απλώς επιβιώνοντας και προχωρώντας μπροστά, και μέχρι την Ευρώπη, όπου οι μετανάστες καταπολεμούν τα ρατσιστικά σύνορα και τις θανατηφόρες απωθήσεις – η αντίσταση είναι παντού.

author: David Swanson
title: Bases Without Names: How Governments Rebrand the U.S. Military Presence
content:
By Mohammed Abunahel, World BEYOND War, September 18, 2026


From “Forces of allied and friendly nations” in

Jordan

 to “agreed locations” in the

Philippines

 and a “rotational presence” in

Australia

, governments use legal and diplomatic language that avoids describing facilities hosting U.S. forces as military bases. Yet changing the terminology does not change these sites’ military function.


When Jordanian Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi rejected claims that his country hosted U.S. military bases, he did not deny the presence of American troops. Instead, he said they were stationed at Jordanian military bases under

a defense cooperation

 agreement for 

Military training

 and described the presence of U.S. bases as forces

“of allied and friendly nations with whom we cooperate on defense and training.”


The distinction was carefully constructed. The forces were American, but the bases were Jordanian. The foreign military presence was acknowledged, while the politically sensitive label, “U.S. military base”, was rejected.


Jordan is not an exception. Across Asia, Europe and the Middle East, governments use an expanding vocabulary to describe sites that accommodate U.S. troops, aircraft, weapons, equipment and logistical systems. They speak of

“agreed locations”,


“joint-use facilities”,


“rotational deployments”

,

“defense cooperation”,

 “

host-nation support

” and, most revealingly,

“places, not bases”.


These terms do not necessarily describe imaginary legal distinctions. The land may remain under the sovereignty of the host state, and the United States may neither own nor formally lease it. Yet focusing exclusively on ownership obscures a more important question: What military functions does the site perform?


Defining a Foreign Military Base by Function


This article adopts a functional definition of a foreign military base rather than relying on the designation preferred by the host or operating government.


World BEYOND War’s global military bases project defines a foreign base

 as “any installation, facility, or site located outside the operating country that is financed, operated, leased, rented, or temporarily accessed by that country. These bases accommodate military personnel, weapons systems, and/or logistical infrastructure, and fulfill diverse functions such as training, information gathering, operational planning, command and control, administrative tasks, and/or weapons storage. Regardless of their size or permanence, these bases inherently support military objectives that may include preparation for or facilitation of military interventions or warfare.”


Under this definition, legal ownership, size and permanence determine the type and scale of a base, not whether it is a base at all.


A facility does not cease to be a foreign military base because the host government owns the land. Nor does it cease to be one because the soldiers rotate, because access is described as temporary, or because local forces use the same runway.


When U.S. personnel, aircraft, weapons, equipment or logistical infrastructure are accommodated outside the United States for military purposes, that site forms part of the U.S. foreign basing network—whatever diplomatic description appears in the agreement.


This definition is broader than the definitions used by many governments. That is precisely why it is analytically useful: it prevents official terminology from determining in advance what the investigation is supposed to establish.


Jordan: U.S. forces in bases that are “not American”


Safadi’s formulation captures the central contradiction. According to remarks reported by

the Qatar News Agency,

 U.S. forces are stationed at Jordanian military bases under a defense cooperation agreement. He placed their presence within Jordan’s wider cooperation with allied and partner countries.


This description focuses on legal ownership: the facilities belong to Jordan, and therefore the government does not classify them as U.S. bases.


According to

the Congressional Research Service

, the agreement provides U.S. forces, personnel and contractors with “unimpeded access to and use” of agreed facilities and areas.


The U.S.–Jordan Defense Cooperation Agreement

, which entered into force in 2021, presents a more operational picture. The permitted activities include:


Visits; training; exercises; maneuvers


Transit; support and related activities


Refueling of aircraft; landing and recovery of …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "We Are the 99%": 15 Years Later, Occupy Wall Street's Impact Is Still Being Felt
content:
Fifteen years ago this week, thousands of activists marched on the Financial District in New York City. They formed the Occupy Wall Street encampment in Zuccotti Park, launching a movement focused on economic inequality that spread across the nation and globe under the slogan, “We are the 99%.” Protesters would go on to sleep in Zuccotti Park for nearly two months before police raided the encampment.


“Occupy Wall Street changed the public’s common sense about class and class struggle and inequality in this country,” says Yotam Marom, who helped organize the Occupy protests in New York City. “It’s hard to see how you get a Bernie Sanders 2016 run without the public shifting its relationship to that story.”


Marom says Occupy participants were inspired by mass protests happening around the world at that time, including the Arab Spring and the anti-austerity movement in Spain known as the Indignados.


Still, “We got it wrong on a lot of things. We had a ton of internal conflict that really jeopardized the project,” he says.


Marom’s new book is

For Louder Days: Reaching Beyond a Politics of Powerlessness

author: Sophia Sheera
title: US Likely Committed War Crimes in Iran, Say UN Experts
content:
The US likely committed war crimes when it killed at least 178 Iranians in two airstrikes in February,

a UN fact-finding mission has said

. 


More than 150 people, including 120 children, were killed after two Tomahawk missiles hit a primary school in Minab, southern Iran, on 28 February. On the same day, 22 civilians were killed in a strike on a sports complex in the southern city of Lamerd. 


The mission said on Thursday it believed the US had indiscriminately attacked civilians and damaged civilian infrastructure in both incidents. It said it applied a “reasonable grounds to believe” standard of proof to reach its conclusions. 


The UN experts said that while the Shajareh Tayyebeh Primary School was next to an Iranian military naval complex, it was “clearly identifiable” as a school.


“Photographs and videos depicting the school… included child-oriented murals painted on exterior walls, school signage, and playground areas,” they wrote.  


They concluded that “the building of the school was the intended point of impact” for two Tomahawk missiles, adding that the attack was not “an errant strike or collateral damage”. 


They added: “When targeting the school building, the US acted wilfully.” 


The US military initially denied responsibility for the attack before launching its own internal probe in March. The results of that investigation are yet to be released. US president Donald Trump

said in June

 that “nobody” hit the school “on purpose”. 


Some families lost multiple children in the attack. 


The UN mission also concluded the US was responsible for using precision strike missiles to disperse 180,000 tungsten pellets over a sports and residential area in the city of Lamerd. As with Tomahawk missiles, the US is the only party in the ongoing war with Iran in possession of precision strike missiles. 


“The strike on Lamerd also amounted to the war crime of launching an indiscriminate attack,” the mission said.


The report also accused Iran of human rights violations and crimes against humanity during its crackdown on anti-government protesters in January, citing torture and use of the death penalty.

title: Ombudsman dismisses human rights complaints vs military even without hearing
content:
Jhed Tamano and Jonila Castro. (Photo courtesy of Hands Off Jhed & Jonila Network)

Trigger warning: Description of state violence, torture, enforced disappearance

MANILA – For two years, not a single hearing was done on the torture and enforced disappearance complaints filed by environmental defenders Jonila Castro and Jhed Tamano against military officials before the Office of the Ombudsman. Despite this, the case was dismissed.

“Two years. No hearings. Then dismissal,” Kalikasan said in a statement. “Instead of reckoning with the evidence provided by the [victim] environmental defenders, the Ombudsman gave greater weight to the accounts of security officials and invoked the presumption of regularity in their favor.”

Tamano and Castro were affiliated with the Alyansa para sa Pagtatanggol sa Kabuhayan, Paninirahan, at Kalikasan ng Manila Bay (AKAP KA Manila Bay) when they were abducted on September 2, 2023 while conducting consultation and research with fishing communities affected by the Manila Bay reclamation projects.

Read: 2 environmental activists defy military, expose abduction

The two later appeared at a press conference on September 19, 2023 organized by the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) which claimed that they were rebel returnees. In front of government officials and military forces, they revealed during the press conference that they were abducted by state security agents.

The cases filed against the state security officials were arbitrary detention, grave coercion, torture, enforced disappearance, grave misconduct, grave abuse of authority, oppression, and prejudicial conduct.

“The abduction of Tamano and Castro represents just one case among hundreds of victims of state-sponsored violence,” Kalikasan said. “[It] is not an isolated case but a deliberate strategy—and we will not allow it to go unchallenged.”

The Ombudsman ruled in favor of the accused state security officials, stating that survivors “failed to discharge such quantum of proofs needed to establish prima facie evidence with reasonable certainty of conviction and substantial evidence against all respondents.”

The Ombudsman decided with only the affidavits submitted by the complainants (Castro and Tamano) and the respondents, namely National Security Council (NSC) Assistant Director General Jonathan Malaya; National Intelligence Coordinating Agency (NICA) Regional Director Niño Balagtas; 70th Infantry Battalion – Philippine Army (IBPA) Commanding Officer Ronnel Dela Cruz and his members Junrey Caballeda, Sherwin Momo, Justin Gutierrez, Manny Trinidad Timbol; several members of the 70th IBPA; aliases “Allan,” “Jak,” “CJ,” and “Bryan”; retired military officials Mario Jose Chico and Mark Leo Santos, both affiliated to the NTF-ELCAC; and Philippine National Police (PNP) officers Carlito Buco, Jr. and Silvestre Colanza.

Read: Victims of abduction recount how and why they lived with Bataan coastal communities

The pieces of evidence scrutinized by the Ombudsman were (1) the logo of the 70th Infantry Battalion on the laptop of one of their interrogators reported by Castro, (2) the admission of their interrogators that they are affiliated with the military, police, and the NTF-ELCAC, and (3) the presence of Justin Gutierrez, who introduced himself as a soldier implicated for inquiring about Castro’s whereabouts, and a certain “Bryan” who was among those who guarded the two during their abduction, at the camp of the 70th Infantry Battalion.

“Other than these, the complainants (Castro and Tamano) failed to submit any concrete evidence supporting their assertion that their abduction and detention were perpetrated by the agents of the state,” the Ombudsman said.

The Ombudsman also stated that between the conflicting narratives, the office gives more credence to the testimonies of the military officials because it ruled that the statements of Castro and Tamano are contradictory for insisting to identify that their abductors are soldiers from the 70th Infantry Battalion.

author: Dyepeson Martins
title: Policiais candidatos fazem autopromoção no YouTube e podem lucrar com violência e machismo
content:
Noite na Marginal Pinheiros, uma das principais artérias de São Paulo: dois jovens negros são abordados por três policiais militares numa viatura. Motivo? Eles caminhavam de forma suspeita, segundo a equipe. A abordagem é seguida por revista, interrogatório e xingamentos por parte dos PMs. “Tu é todo ladrãozão, né”, comentou um dos policiais.


Nada ilegal ou suspeito foi identificado na dupla. Mesmo assim, a ação foi exaltada em um

vídeo publicado no YouTube

pelo

Diretor Elias Junior, candidato a deputado estadual pelo MDB

. “O tamanho do viaduto ficou pequeno quando viram a ROTA”, diz o título da publicação. Um formato sensacionalista que se repete entre outros youtubers que disputam as eleições de 2026 e integram a lista dos que mais monetizaram explorando operações policiais. Alguns dos vídeos contêm deboche, humilhação e truculência, expondo, além dos próprios policiais, moradores e suspeitos, sobretudo em regiões periféricas de grandes cidades.


Apuração exclusiva da

Agência Pública

, em parceria com a plataforma

Zeeng,

 mostra que um candidato com muitos seguidores pode ganhar até R$ 8 mil por mês no YouTube com vídeos sobre operações e abordagens das polícias. O levantamento considerou os 15 candidatos influencers com maior monetização sobre ocorrências policiais em 2026: eles podem ter ganhado até R$ 64,6 mil na soma dos vídeos (entre shorts e vídeos longos) postados no YouTube de 1º de janeiro a 25 de agosto deste ano.


Os valores podem ser ainda maiores, pois o levantamento considera o pagamento estimado por views do YouTube, o que não leva em conta outras redes sociais e possíveis patrocínios negociados diretamente pelos candidatos, a exemplo de divulgação de cursos e produtos.


Ao todo, sete partidos de direita e centro-direita compõem o levantamento: Podemos, MDB, PP, PL, Avante, União Brasil e Republicanos. Os nomes analisados possuem vínculo direto com a

Polícia Militar

, Polícia Civil, Polícia Rodoviária Federal e Guarda Civil Metropolitana de São Paulo. A exceção é Elias Junior, que é diretor cinematográfico, mas acompanha operações e explora a estética policial.


Dos 15 youtubers listados pela reportagem, 14 utilizam ocorrências policiais para divulgar a própria imagem, a maioria em condutas que não são condizentes com as normas das Polícias Civil e Militar de São Paulo sobre uso das redes sociais.

 Além disso, parlamentares licenciados dos cargos não têm prerrogativa para se apresentarem como autoridades policiais – e nem usarem distintivo ou equipamentos da corporação, conforme confirmado pela Secretaria de Segurança Pública de São Paulo.


Por que isso importa?


As Polícias costumam ter normas de como seus agentes devem usar as redes sociais – muitas delas vedam o uso de palavras depreciativas ou de fardas e dispositivos.

Cerca de 6% de todos os candidatos destas eleições são ligados a forças de segurança.

Partidos de direita e extrema direita têm defendido medidas inconstitucionais de endurecimento da punição a crimes.


O líder na estimativa de arrecadação é o

deputado federal e candidato à reeleição, delegado Palumbo (PODE-SP)

, que pode ter faturado cerca de R$ 64,6 mil desde o início do ano, acumulando mais de 26 milhões de visualizações no período analisado. Mesmo licenciado do cargo de Policial Civil, Palumbo aparece nos vídeos participando de operações, sobretudo relacionadas ao tráfico de drogas.


Mesmo licenciado do cargo de Policial Civil, o deputado federal Delegado Palumbo (de marrom) participa de operações e posta no YouTube –


este vídeo foi retirado após contato da reportagem


Na maioria das ocorrências, ele caminha ao lado dos agentes, auxilia e até mesmo protagoniza interrogatórios. Os títulos utilizados nos conteúdos são majoritariamente chamativos e com palavras fortes. “São duas opções, c4deia ou caixão – dessa vez ele foi parar na c4deia”,

descreve uma publicação de 20 de julho de 2026

, que começa com policiais imobilizando de forma agressiva um homem na rua. “Não estamos te esculachando não, você está sendo tratado como tem que ser tratado”, diz um dos agentes. Depois de ter sido procurado pela reportagem, Palumbo retirou o vídeo do ar, mas não respondeu aos questionamentos.

title: Devon And Somerset Staghounds Recreate The Horror Of The Barle Stag
content:
Thirty-two years on from the controversy of the Barle stag, the excuses may have changed, but for the hunted stag the suffering is horribly familiar.


More than three decades have passed since the death of the Barle stag became one of the most notorious episodes associated with stag hunting on Exmoor. Yet for those who witnessed what happened on Saturday 12th September 2026, the events along the River Barle carried disturbing echoes of the past – a past that, sadly, does not seem so very different from the present.


On Saturday, this magnificent stag was found quickly in the boggy woodland below Twitchen, and from there the pursuit began.


The stag was described as “a very fine up and coming stag” by a deer expert from Wildlife Guardian


A sab from North Dorset Hunt Saboteurs struggled to keep pace as the stag was chased across Molland Common and West Anstey Common. The stag crossed the road just moments before sabs arrived.


From there, the stag continued towards the River Barle at Mountsey Castle. It was there that sabs saw him bursting across a track in front of point riders and a quad bike before heading down and into the river.


By this stage the pursuit had clearly taken a terrible toll on the animal. Relays of hounds are typically deployed in pairs during stag hunting, allowing a pursuit to continue for hours. On this occasion the chase lasted around two hours before the stag was brought to bay.


Relays of pairs of hounds are used during the pursuit of the stag.


“At bay” is a hunting term to describe the point at which a hunted stag has stopped fleeing and turns to face his pursuers. It is often the culmination of an exhausting chase: an animal pushed to the point where escape is impossible, confronted by those pursuing him and facing what may come next.


The powerful wild animal who had crossed miles of difficult country was now struggling simply to continue. He was heaving for breath and, at one point appeared to be unable to even hold his head up properly. Instead of running, he was reduced to a slow walk.


And still the pursuit continued.


This is the image that cuts through the arguments used to defend stag hunting. Whatever terminology, smokescreen or justification is employed, it boils down to an exhausted, tormented animal desperately trying to keep moving.


The stag managed a final slow trot upstream before exhaustion overcomes him for the final time.


A sab entered the river after him, the Barle was shallow after a summer of drought. The river offered a moment of respite for the animal, he even managed a slow trot upstream, with the cooling water seeming to relieve him slightly, despite everything he had already endured.


A hound was also in the river, but appeared not to have picked up the scent. The sab continued to follow, the stones underfoot were slippery, making progress difficult while they also tried to protect their camera equipment and preserve the footage already recorded. The footage in stag hunting is important.


A small child was taking part in the obscene spectacle


Documenting is particularly important in stag hunting, because intervention at the final stages can be extraordinarily difficult.


During fox hunts, direct intervention by saboteurs can sometimes give a hunted animal the opportunity to escape. With an exhausted stag standing at bay, the situation is quite different.


On several occasions, sabs have managed to reach a stag standing at bay and position themselves close to the animal. Their presence may offer some protection for a limited period, but the stag is already frightened and exhausted.


Pressure continues and if the stag is frightened into moving again, even one final desperate burst can take him beyond the immediate protection of saboteurs.


If the stag cannot be saved, then at the very least what happens to him should not be hidden. People should be able to see what these animals endure and understand what the pursuit at the heart of this so-called “sport” actually looks like.


The hunts gunman, Shaun Kelloway, then dismounted from his horse, and carrying his gun, began following the stag on foot along the riverbank.


Gunman Shaun Kelloway dismounted, and carried his gun, before shooting the animal.


Sabs were hindered and obstructed by hunt supporters, while further ahead hounds could be heard being “hunted on”.


Yet despite everything – the woodland, the commons, the roads, the hills and finally the river, this extraordinary animal kept …

: dasselbe Pferd um 14 und um 21 Uhr desselben Tages, bei 31 Grad. Das kantonale Veterinäramt erklärte zu einer Temperaturlimite, die Tierschutzgesetzgebung biete

«keine Grundlage für derartige Anordnungen»

. An dieser Lücke setzen die drei Vorstösse an.


Die

Tierschutzverordnung

 regelt, wie viel Bewegung ein Pferd mindestens braucht – nicht, wie lange es vor der Kutsche arbeiten darf. Hitzeschutz schreibt sie für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine vor, für Pferde im Geschirr fehlt jede Bestimmung. Die Motion von Nationalrätin Meret Schneider (Grüne) beauftragt den Bundesrat deshalb, die Verordnung zu ergänzen: mit einer Höchstdauer des täglichen Einsatzes und Ruhezeiten, Einsatzgrenzen bei Hitze und einem Fachkundenachweis für das gewerbliche Kutschieren.


«Die Tierschutzverordnung kennt Hitzeschutz für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine – nur für Pferde, die bei grosser Hitze Kutschen über den Asphalt ziehen, fehlt jede Regel», sagt Meret Schneider. «Diese Lücke kann der Bundesrat auf dem Verordnungsweg schliessen, ohne Gesetzesänderung.»


Wie gross die Risiken auch für Menschen sind, zeigte der

Unfall im Val Roseg

 vom 16. August: Die Bremsleistung einer Kutsche reichte nicht mehr aus, ein Pferd stürzte, das Fuhrwerk prallte gegen einen Baum. Eine 73-jährige Frau starb, zwölf Mitfahrende wurden verletzt. Wer ein Tierfuhrwerk lenkt, braucht nach Bundesrecht einzig das vollendete vierzehnte Altersjahr, eine Prüfung besteht nicht.


Im Grossen Rat verlangt Susanne Clauss (SP) mit der Interpellation «Hitzefrei für Kutschpferde?» Auskunft darüber, wie viele Pferde im Kanton Bern für gewerbliche Kutschfahrten eingesetzt werden, wie der Kanton kontrolliert und was aus den Meldungen aus der Bevölkerung wird.


«Verbindliche Regeln nehmen den sorgfältigen Betrieben nichts weg», sagt Susanne Clauss. «Sie stoppen die Betriebe, die ihr Pferd von Mittag bis Mitternacht durcharbeiten lassen.»


In der Stadt Bern fragt Tobias Sennhauser, Stadtrat von Tier im Fokus (TIF), welche Bewilligungen die Stadt für Kutschenbetriebe erteilt, welche Vorgaben für die Kutschenfahrten des städtischen Tierparks gelten und wie weit ihr Handlungsspielraum reicht – bis hin zu einem Verbot.


«Die Kutsche ist Unterhaltung auf Kosten der Tiere», sagt Tobias Sennhauser. «Wir wollen von der Stadt wissen, ob sie im 21. Jahrhundert daran festhalten will, Pferde zwischen Tram, Bussen und Menschenmengen einzuspannen.»


Andere Städte sind weiter:

Berlin

 lässt seit 2019 ab 30 Grad im Schatten keine Kutschfahrten mehr zu, Barcelona, Madrid und Málaga haben den gewerblichen Kutschenbetrieb ganz beendet.


Der Beitrag

Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund

 erschien zuerst auf

Tier im Fokus (TIF)

.

author: Animal Rising Press
title: Chris Packham Joins Woman Living In Pig Crate During 21-Day Stand Against Factory Farming
content:
Wildlife presenter and former RSPCA president Chris Packham joined Michelle Farnham inside a pig farrowing crate outside the National Gallery today, where she has been living for over a week to highlight suffering on British factory farms.

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham is living inside the crate 24 hours a day as part of a living art installation outside the National Gallery. She does not leave the crate at any point, day or night, from 1 to 22 September. [1]

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham is living inside the crate 24 hours a day as part of a living art installation outside the National Gallery. She does not leave the crate at any point, day or night, from 1 to 22 September. [1]

Farrowing crates are still used in approximately 92% of indoor pig production systems, confining more than 200,000 mother pigs each year [2] - but Animal Rising says the crates are just one part of a much wider problem, and is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040.

Farrowing crates are still used in approximately 92% of indoor pig production systems, confining more than 200,000 mother pigs each year [2] - but Animal Rising says the crates are just one part of a much wider problem, and is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040.

The action follows Animal Rising’s release of hidden-camera footage documenting the life of Luna, a mother pig kept in a farrowing crate on a Suffolk factory farm. Over 19,000 people have now signed a petition calling for her release to sanctuary. [3] [4]

The action follows Animal Rising’s release of hidden-camera footage documenting the life of Luna, a mother pig kept in a farrowing crate on a Suffolk factory farm. Over 19,000 people have now signed a petition calling for her release to sanctuary. [3] [4]

Chris Packham joined Michelle in the crate today (09/09/26) on her ninth consecutive day living inside behind its bars in Trafalgar Square.

Animal Rising is now calling on the government to commit to the end of factory farming by 2040, arguing the scale of suffering in intensive farming systems can no longer be ignored.

Visiting today, Chris Packham said:

Packham stepped down as president of the RSPCA in December 2024 following Animal Rising investigations into RSPCA Assured farms and slaughterhouses, saying he had seen “no meaningful change” in response to the findings. [5] [6]

Michelle Farnham has spent years examining conditions inside British animal farms. She studied Animal Management for two years and has since reviewed hundreds of hours of undercover footage recorded inside UK pig farms, working alongside veterinary and animal welfare law experts to assess conditions, including during Animal Rising’s investigations into RSPCA Assured farms and slaughterhouses.

Farrowing crates can confine mother pigs for four to five weeks at a time around giving birth and nursing their piglets, leaving them unable to turn around or take more than a step forward or back. Sows are put through this cycle repeatedly, returning to the crates with successive litters until they are eventually culled.

Animal Rising released its investigation into Luna’s life last week, after documenting her for a month on a factory farm in Suffolk. Hidden-camera footage narrated by Michelle shows Luna giving birth and nursing her piglets while confined inside a farrowing crate, unable to turn around or freely interact with her piglets. Animal Rising is calling for Luna to be released to a sanctuary home that has been offered to her, alongside its wider call for the Government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040.

Over 19,000 people have signed the petition since Luna’s story was released.

Michelle and Animal Rising spokespeople are available for interviews and comment at the crate outside the National Gallery. Please email press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691 to arrange.

author: webadmin
title: Convicted Huntsman ‘Bloods’ A Young Child At The Flint & Denbigh Hunt
content:
At the beginning of this year the Hunt Saboteurs Association was sent some of the most disturbing images we have seen in over sixty years of campaigning against bloodsports.


They show a young child having their face smeared with the blood of a freshly slaughtered fox by huntsman Conall McGrath, then of the Flint & Denbigh Hunt who operate in North Wales.


On receiving the images, the HSA immediately forwarded them to the police but, many months on, we are not aware of any action being taken.


Conall McGrath holds a dead fox aloft as a small child approaches. Terrier men smile behind them, one is holding a terrier.


The practice shown in the images is known as ‘blooding’. Blooding is an initiation ritual practised by hunts which ‘celebrate’ a hunter’s first successful kill. Prince Harry wrote about being ‘blooded’ after stalking a stag as a 15 year old boy.


Blooding relies on the animal being freshly killed as – obviously – the blood needs to be wet. The images show a fox whose blood is still fresh. It is inconceivable that the fox in the image is anything other than a fox killed moments earlier by the hunt.


In the first image, McGrath can be seen holding the body of the fox and encouraging the hounds to attack it as the child approaches. Behind the child stand two grinning terrier men: Rob Smith Jnr on the left, and Joe Scillario on the right, holding a terrier.


In the second image, McGrath grabs the child’s hair with one hand and smears blood on their face with the other.


The photographs are believed to have been taken on the 17th January 2026. On this same date, hounds from the hunt were filmed out of control on the busy A55, footage which we published at the time. You can watch the video sent in by an

unsuspecting motorist here

.


To protect their welfare, the HSA is concealing the identity of the child.


McGrath smears the dead fox’s blood on the child’s face


Incredibly, McGrath was convicted of illegal hunting just a few months before the images were taken, when he was a whipper-in for the

Blackmore and Sparkford Vale Hunt

. This incident made national news when the hunt were caught on camera hunting and killing a fox by North Dorset Hunt Sabs.


McGrath was one of four men convicted for his role in illegal fox hunting at Pelsham Farm in December 2023.


An HSA spokesperson commented:


“Over twenty years on from the passing of the Hunting Act, these harrowing images show continued illegal hunting and the utter determination of today’s hunters to induct a new generation of vulnerable youngsters into their sick and criminal activities.


This week we have already highlighted safeguarding concerns in relation to a private school whose ‘Games Coach’ was recently convicted of illegal hunting, whilst pupils of the school were present.These failings are a direct result of a Hunting Act that is not fit for purpose – we need much stiffer penalties to deter the likes of McGrath.


Following the recent consultation on trail hunting the government must immediately follow through on its manifesto promise and come down hard on those who break the law and hunt wildlife with packs of dogs”.


The post

Convicted Huntsman ‘Bloods’ A Young Child At The Flint & Denbigh Hunt

 appeared first on

Hunt Saboteurs Association

.

title: Ni mare, ni ciel, ni terre pour les canards de Carrefour
content:
Une enquête de L214 a filmé, en juillet et en août 2026, un élevage de canards de Barbarie de Sèvremoine (49) dont la viande est vendue sous la marque Carrefour Extra. Onze mille cinq cents oiseaux aquatiques y sont enfermés sur un caillebotis de plastique, sans litière, sans aucun dispositif leur permettant de plonger la tête dans l'eau. On les mutile pour qu'ils arrivent à survivre assez longtemps dans ces conditions ; Ils arrivent dans l'élevage le bec épointé. Leurs griffes sont coupées. Au ramassage, ils sont empoignés brutalement par le cou et balancés dans les caisses de transport.

Votre charte éthique fournisseurs engage pourtant chacun de vos fournisseurs à respecter les réglementations en matière de bien-être animal et à bannir les actes de cruauté envers les animaux.

Je vous demande d'écarter de vos rayons les produits de cet élevage et de tout élevage de canards conduit de la même façon. Et je vous demande de signer le Plant Protein Pact, pour réduire de moitié le nombre d'animaux tués pour vos approvisionnements d'ici 2030.

Ces images ont été filmées en juillet et en août 2026 dans un élevage de canards de Barbarie de Sèvremoine, dans le Maine-et-Loire. 11 500 oiseaux y sont enfermés dans un seul bâtiment fermé.

Les canards de Barbarie sont des oiseaux aquatiques de forêt marécageuse. Ici, ils vivent sur un caillebotis de plastique qui couvre toute la surface, sans un mètre carré de litière, avec environ 700 cm² pour chacun, à peine plus qu'une feuille A4. Pour toute eau, une pipette au-dessus d'une coupelle de quelques centimètres : rien qui permette de plonger, ne serait-ce que la tête.

Les canetons arrivent dans l'élevage le bec épointé. Ils ont aussi les griffes coupées. Les animaux ont le plumage souillé et les pattes couvertes de plaques brunes et croûteuses. Certains, pattes écartées, ne se déplacent plus par eux-mêmes. Des cadavres restent au sol parmi les vivants.

Au bout des 83 jours d'engraissement, les ramasseurs vident le bâtiment en une heure et demie. Les canards sont empoignés brutalement par le cou, plusieurs à la fois dans chaque main, puis balancés dans les caisses de transport, entassés les uns sur les autres.

Leur viande est vendue sous la marque Carrefour Extra. La comédienne Aure Atika, qui commente ces images, demande à l'enseigne d'écarter ces produits de ses rayons et de s'engager à signer le Plant Protein Pact.

author: GPT
title: Tierschutz kritisiert den Abbau der Taubenschläge
content:
Gemeinsame Medienmitteilung von Stadttauben Schweiz und Tier im Fokus (TIF)


Bern, 7. September 2026 – Die Stadt Bern muss sparen. Das bekommen nun auch die Tauben zu spüren: Von 2027 bis 2030 will der Gemeinderat beim Taubenmanagement jährlich 81’254 Franken einsparen. Betroffen ist der Tierpark Bern, der die Stadttauben im Auftrag der Stadt in mehreren Schlägen betreut. Er soll

«Teile dieses Angebots» einstellen

, wie es im Finanzplan des Gemeinderats heisst.


Der Verein Stadttauben Schweiz kritisiert diesen Abbau. «Betreute Taubenschläge sind das wirksamste Mittel, um die Zahl der Stadttauben tief und die Tiere gesund zu halten», sagt Nina Bachellerie, Präsidentin des Vereins.


Seit der Gemeinderat die Taubenkontrolle 2010 dem Tierpark Bern übertragen hat, ist die Population von über 10’000 Tieren auf rund 1’500 gesunken – betreut in acht Schlägen in der Altstadt und den Quartieren. Die Tiere werden

jährlich geimpft und tierärztlich kontrolliert

, ihr Kot fällt im Schlag an statt an Fassaden und Haltestellen: rechnerisch rund 85 Tonnen weniger pro Jahr. Das Berner Konzept gilt als «weltweit einzigartig», wie kürzlich

im «Bund» zu lesen war

 – Städte aus ganz Europa lassen sich die Praxis erklären.


Interpellation verlangt eine Bilanz


Was das Taubenmanagement kostet, ist bekannt: rund 240’000 Franken pro Jahr (Stand 2022). Was es der Stadt erspart, hat der Gemeinderat hingegen nie beziffert. Tier im Fokus (TIF) hat deshalb die Interpellation «Was leistet das Berner Taubenmanagement für die Stadt?» im Berner Stadtrat eingereicht. Sie verlangt Auskunft über die vermiedenen Reinigungs- und Instandsetzungskosten sowie über den Beitrag der Taubenschläge an den Gesundheitsschutz, den Tourismus und den Erhalt des UNESCO-Welterbes.


«Der Gemeinderat kennt die Kosten des Taubenmanagements, aber nicht seinen Nutzen», sagt Tobias Sennhauser, Stadtrat von Tier im Fokus (TIF). «Mit dem Abbau der Taubenschläge steigt das Risiko, dass die Verschmutzungen an den Fassaden wieder zunehmen.»


Der Stadtrat entscheidet in der Budgetdebatte vom 10. und 17. September über die Kürzung.


Der Beitrag

Tierschutz kritisiert den Abbau der Taubenschläge

 erschien zuerst auf

Tier im Fokus (TIF)

title: Türk dizi sektörünün tarikatı: Ekranda kurulan ‘devlet aklı’
content:
Türkiye’de televizyon dizileri uzun yıllar yalnızca eğlence ürünü olarak tartışıldı. Ancak Kurtlar Vadisi bunun sınırlarını değiştirdi. 2003’te başlayan dizi, mafya dünyasını anlatırken kısa sürede devlet, istihbarat, asker, siyaset ve “derin devlet” ilişkilerini merkeze aldı.

Dizinin temel anlatısı basitti: Görünen devletin arkasında, ‘ülkenin bekası’ için çalışan başka bir yapı vardır. Bu yapının bazı mensupları suç örgütleriyle ilişki kurabilir, hukuk dışına çıkabilir, gerektiğinde öldürebilir. Buradaki temel ayrım ise “devlet” ile “devlet adına hareket eden kötü unsurlar” arasındadır.

Bu anlatı, 1996 Susurluk kazasının ardından Türkiye’de genişleyen tartışmaların popüler kültürdeki karşılıklarından biri oldu. Susurluk’ta siyasetçi, polis ve mafya ilişkilerinin aynı araçta ortaya çıkması, dizinin dünyasına doğrudan malzeme sağladı. Ancak dizinin asıl gücü burada değildi. Gerçek olayları doğrudan haber olarak vermek yerine onları kahramanlık ve devlet sırrı anlatısına dönüştürmesiydi.

Polat Alemdar, görünürde mafyanın içine sokulmuş bir devlet görevlisiydi. Böylece izleyiciye şu mesaj veriliyordu: Mafyanın içindeki bazı aktörler aslında devletin operasyonunun parçası olabilir. “İyi” ile “kötü” arasındaki sınır, hukuktan değil, devletin çıkarından geçiyordu.

Dizinin gerçek kişilerle ilişkisi konusunda yıllardır çok sayıda iddia ortaya atıldı. Çakıcı, Veli Küçük, Hiram Abas ve çeşitli istihbarat görevlileri ile karakterler arasında benzerlikler kuruldu. Bunların önemli bir bölümü doğrudan doğrulanmış “karakter eşleşmeleri” değil.

2026’da Silivri Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, 2011’de cezaevinde hayatını kaybeden eski MİT görevlisi Kaşif Kozinoğlu’nun ölümüyle ilgili soruşturmayı yeniden yürütmeye başladı. Soruşturma kapsamında Kurtlar Vadisi senaristleri Raci Şaşmaz, Bahadır Özdener ve Cüneyt Aysan “bilgi sahibi” sıfatıyla ifade verdi.

Çünkü dizideki Kazım Kaşifoğlu karakteri ile gerçek hayattaki Kaşif Kozinoğlu arasında dikkat çekici benzerlikler bulunuyor. Soruşturma, karakterin ölümü, bazı sahnelerin zamanlaması ve dizideki başka ayrıntıların incelenmesini de kapsıyor. Konunun bilirkişi heyetince değerlendirilmesine karar verildi.

Raci Şaşmaz ise savcılık ifadesinde dizinin açık kaynaklardan beslendiğini, Kazım Kaşifoğlu karakterinin istihbarat içindeki çatışmaları anlatmak amacıyla oluşturulduğunu ve gerçek kişilerle bağlantısının bulunmadığını söyledi. Şaşmaz ayrıca “legal ya da illegal hiçbir güç ya da suç odağıyla” bağlantıları olmadığını savundu.

Peki, Kurtlar Vadisi gerçeği mi ekrana taşıdı, yoksa gerçeklik hakkında yeni bir anlatı mı kurdu?

Raci ve Necati Şaşmaz’ın aile çevresindeki Kadiri bağlantıları yıllardır basına yansıdı. Kurtlar Vadisi'nin arkasındaki Şaşmaz ailesinin dini bağlantıları yeni bir tartışma değil. Raci ve Necati Şaşmaz’ın babası Abdülkadir Şaşmaz, Elazığ merkezli Kadiri çevresinin önde gelen isimlerinden biri olarak basına yansıdı. Şaşmaz kardeşlerin bu çevreyle ilişkileri de yıllar içinde haber ve mahkeme dosyalarına konu oldu. Necati Şaşmaz da röportajlarından birinde bunu itiraf ediyor ve yeni mürşidin kendisi olacağını da açıklıyor.

2000’li yılların başında Kurtlar Vadisi henüz yeni yayındayken dizinin kimlerden bilgi aldığı, karakterlerin gerçek hayattaki karşılıklarının kimler olduğu ve yapım çevresinin devlet içerisindeki güvenlik bürokrasisiyle ilişkileri hakkında çeşitli iddialar ortaya atıldı.

Bugün yeniden gündeme gelen eski bir MİT raporu bu nedenle kritik. Kaşif Kozinoğlu’na atfedilen raporda, dizinin yapım çevresi, bazı suç örgütleri ve güvenlik bürokrasisi arasında ilişkiler bulunduğu ileri sürülüyordu. Raporda Raci Şaşmaz’ın yanı sıra Osman Sınav, çeşitli mafya figürleri, Yavuz Ataç ve Korkut Eken gibi isimlerin de geçtiği aktarılıyor.

Raporda ayrıca dizideki bazı karakterlerin gerçek suç örgütü liderlerinden esinlendiği ileri sürülüyor. Örneğin, Süleyman Çakır karakteri Alaattin Çakıcı ile ilişkilendiriliyor. Süleyman Çakır karakterini oynayan Oktay Kaynarca da Çakıcı’dan “abim” diye bahsediyor ve ilişkileri olduğunu açıkça itiraf ediyor.

Üstelik Şaşmaz kardeşlerin sonraki projeleri bu sürekliliği tartışmaya açıyor. Raci Şaşmaz, 2015’te ATV’nin resmi duyurusunda Eşkıya Dünyaya Hükümdar Olmaz'ın yapımcısı ve senaristi olarak yer aldı. Dizinin merkezinde yine devlet, silah, mafya ve “vatan” ilişkileri bulunuyordu. Dolayısıyla mesele tek bir dizi değil.
